text:
nina: spotting weird quota/banter on console: some tenants pinned to v1 are intermittently getting v2 routing and the deprecation banner keeps popping up. only ~0.08% of traffic but billing flagged it

rahul: that likely came from the router precedence tweak from last week. we briefly had headers override token affinity for debugging. ops-bot:deploy-1839 did that Friday night

tom: confirmed. change was pushed to help debug a flaky canary but it wasn’t gated behind hostpool flags. small fraction of requests carrying debug headers got routed to v2

jin: UI logic: banner triggers on any cross-route spike >0.05% over 24h. given tiny percent this fires for some tenants which is noisy

sarah: customers are confused by global banner and some reached out to support complaining about mixed-model responses

billing: we’ve seen micro-billing for v2 rates on those misrouted requests. need to catalog affected tenants for credits

nina: can we get an audit query to list misrouted requests?

rahul: quick audit: ```sql
SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS misrouted, SUM(billed_tokens) AS billed_tokens
FROM route_log
WHERE routed_version='v2' AND token_affinity='v1' AND timestamp > now()- interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY misrouted DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

tom: ran it, found 14 tenants, total misrouted requests ~3.2k across 24h (~0.08% of their traffic). I'll roll back the precedence change immediately

ops-bot:log: created RW-4722-revert-router-change

jin: UX idea: change banner rules to include context: require either sustained rate or >N tenants affected. propose: banner if (pct>0.1% over 6h) OR (pct>0.05% AND affected_tenants>25). Also add "Reason: routing debug header" in banner with link to affected list

ux: +1, and make the default banner scoped (show only to affected tenant admins) instead of global. global banners are panic-inducing

billing: for credits I need a CSV with tenant_id, misrouted, billed_tokens, and time window. Finance will compute refund = billed_tokens * (v2_rate - v1_rate) and issue credits. Please tag accounts team

rahul: plan of action:
1) revert router precedence change (tom) ETA 15m
2) gate header-overrides behind a hostpool feature flag and only allow in test envs (rahul) ETA today
3) add header signing so only prod-signed proxies can set debug headers (jin) ETA next week
4) backfill billing CSV and notify finance (tom + billing) ETA EOD
5) UX: refine banner logic & scope (ux + nina) ETA tomorrow

ops-bot:deploy-1845 started rollback by tom

tom: rollback done, routing back to token-affinity-first. re-running audit now

rahul: re-run shows misrouted count dropped to 0. Good. Will follow up with PR to gate the feature and add an integration test to prevent accidental opt-in

billing: will prepare credits file and draft comms; please freeze any further header changes until we have header signing in place

sarah: support prep note: include a short FAQ explaining what happened, why some customers saw mixed responses, and how refunds will be handled

nina: agree. add a short postmortem if credits exceed $1k or >10 accounts impacted

ops-bot:log: RW-4722 closed (rollback complete).
